title: fss.supervisor_transcript_report.v1
description: Explicit --transcript yes wrapper for the legacy caller-score supervisor simulation. The nested v1 report and historical numerical receipts retain their original fields and bytes. Ordered per-window transcripts bind actual fusion queries/decisions or resets, bounded state, supporting domains and predecessor history. The supervisor transcript independently binds deterministic report fields, cancellation and window metadata; elapsed_ns is excluded from digest identity. Source custody, calibration qualification, statistical independence, anytime false-alarm validity and effect authority remain unverified. Replay original inputs and compare receipts; structural schema validation alone does not verify them.

report.description: Unchanged fss.supervisor_report.v1 projection from SupervisorReport::to_json. Its existing owner supplies the complete numerical, window and cancellation fields.

fusion_transcripts.description: Exactly one row for each report window, in execution order with identical window index and timestamp. The first transition has no predecessor; subsequent observation and reset receipts retain ancestry.
